name: zubra-js-framework-benchmark
description: Zubra's implementation for krausest/js-framework-benchmark (frameworks/keyed/zubra, in its layout), a runner that checks it with the benchmark's own steps, and a script-time profiler. `build` uses the published packages, as the benchmark's repository would; `build:checkout` this checkout's runtime and plugin, with the compiler $ZUBRA_COMPILER names.

scripts.build: cd frameworks/keyed/zubra && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build-prod
scripts.build:checkout: cd frameworks/keyed/zubra && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm install --no-save --no-audit --no-fund --install-links=false ../../../../../runtime ../../../../../plugin && npm run build-prod
